gloss: to bake, to grill, to burn

definitions.gloss: to bake, to grill, to roast
definitions.explanation: To cook food using dry heat, such as in an oven or on a grill.
To damage or destroy something with fire or heat.
To create copies by burning data onto a disc.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Pair: ⟦{焼|や}ける→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧ (intransitive, to burn/be grilled). Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{焼|や}く (bake/grill/burn X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {焼|や}いている = 'is grilling/baking.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{焼|や}く (bake bread)
- ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{焼|や}く (grill meat)
- ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{焼|や}く (grill fish)
- CD⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{焼|や}く (burn a CD)
- ⟦{日焼|ひや}け→日焼け：15469_hiyake⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (get sunburned—related)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {焼|や}く (transitive): bake/burn X
- ⟦{焼|や}ける→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧ (intransitive): X burns/is grilled

FOOD-RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{焼|や}き{鳥|とり}→焼き鳥：04952_yakitori⟧ (grilled chicken skewers)
- ⟦{焼|や}き{魚|ざかな}→焼き魚：13406_yakizakana⟧ (grilled fish)
- ⟦お{好|この}み{焼|や}き→お好み焼き：10252_okonomiyaki⟧ (Japanese savory pancake)
